name: browser-use
headline: GetSpecStory - Sync AI Dev Conversations
short_description: Sync AI development conversations from IDEs or terminals to the cloud. File issues and requests. Benefits developers and operations teams by preserving and sharing knowledge.
author: specstoryai

sections.overview:
getspecstory is a command-line tool that records AI development conversations happening in your IDE or terminal and syncs them to the cloud. It preserves the context and knowledge from your AI-assisted development work, making it easy to share insights across your team. The tool helps developers and operations teams maintain a searchable history of their AI interactions, reducing knowledge silos and improving collaboration. By automatically capturing these conversations, getspecstory enables better documentation of development decisions and technical discussions without manual effort.
Automatically save every AI interaction during coding sessions for future reference.
Sync local coding history to the cloud for centralized access and organization.
Generate summaries and insights from past AI interactions to improve future coding practices.
Share specific solutions or code snippets with team members directly from the SpecStory interface.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
